title: Step Order Configuration
description: Defines the strict waterfall dependency DAG, pipeline policies, and downstream consumer mappings for the spec-driven development workflow.

version.description: Semantic version of the step_order configuration format.

_notes.description: Human-readable documentation notes explaining design decisions. Not consumed by tooling.

policy.description: Pipeline execution policy governing dependency resolution.

mode.description: Pipeline execution mode. Currently only 'strict_waterfall' is supported.

allow_self_dependency.description: When false, 'dependency-order-lint' reports a prompt that names its own step's spec file as an input. The generated step_metadata never lists a step as its own input: a link to a kind in same_step_kinds is not a step edge.

allow_forward_dependency.description: Whether a step may depend on a step that appears later in the pipeline ordering.

steps.description: Ordered list of step IDs defining the strict waterfall sequence. Position determines dependency eligibility.

items.description: Step identifier: two-digit number optionally followed by a single lowercase letter suffix (a, b, or c).

downstream_consumers.description: Maps each step ID to the list of steps that actively consume its output. Read by 'specdev prompt-context', the context loaders, 'dag-lint' and 'dependency-order-lint'.

items.description: A step ID (two-digit, optionally with letter suffix) that consumes this step's output.

additionalProperties.description: Array of step IDs that consume output from this step.

declared_edges.description: Step dependency edges carried by hand: context reads that no stored x-link carries (a computed link, a read by label, or a step with no annotations). Each item is [producer, consumer]; the generator counts it as a required edge, so it appears in step_metadata and downstream_consumers. tools/step_order.json is generated by 'specdev registry-generate'; this key and version, steps and policy are the only keys edited by hand.

items.description: A [producer, consumer] pair of step IDs: the consumer reads the producer's output.

step_metadata.description: Per-step declarative metadata: upstream spec inputs. Optional — when present, the consistency linter validates required_spec_inputs against the inverse of downstream_consumers. The field is independently optional; the linter treats omission as an empty list and still catches missing edges via the cross-source comparison.

additionalProperties.description: Metadata block for a single step. The field is optional to allow incremental per-step migration; the linter validates whatever is declared and treats absence as an empty list. Keys at this level must reference steps declared in the top-level `steps` array — phantom step keys are caught by `_lint_step_metadata_consistency` (E543).

required_spec_inputs.description: Step IDs whose output this step ingests as input. Must match the inverse of downstream_consumers (a step is listed here iff the producer lists this step in its downstream_consumers). Optional — when omitted, the linter treats this side as empty and surfaces any missing edge via E543.

items.description: A step ID that produces upstream input for this step.
